eyebrow: A domain as an accidental kill switch
code:
WannaCry (2017) checked whether
one long, random-looking domain
was already registered before
encrypting a victim's files.

A researcher registered it --
halting every future infection.
Now one of the most documented
network IOCs in security history.
caption: Network IOCs get tracked and blocked exactly like file hashes do.
